title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Have you heard anything about spring training? Hammer and Galli said it’s in Lakeland
Ron isn’t getting back to me (I wonder why)
And I just heard from a coach that he heard Detroit because of corona
I heard Florida from PR yesterday on a conference call.
Ok
Do you think it’s a situation where they’re going to see how much heat they take before changing course?
I have no clue.
Like, Florida is peaking. I don’t think it’s egregious but
Egregious to have them train there. It’s probably a better situation for isolating them but still
Yeah, I don’t think they should train there but that’s my two cents.
Who were Hammer and Galli’s source
Ron, I’m guessing.
Why put something out there like that so sudden?
You act like I know who tipped them off. I assume it was Ron or someone in PR though
No ... I’m just thinking it out, like, logically, it’s Ron. But if you’re Ron, why do that? Because the team wants to hold it there and is gonna throw it out there to see the reaction?
I would assume, yes. Seems like they want to see what backlash is like.
https://twitter.com/BNightengale/status/1275606778416230400
An hour lol
Bottom of the 8th inning on Sept. 14 ... “Great seeing you, Greg.”
Look at you taking social distancing seriously
Did you see me AtingReds
Yeah
A lot of ways I could’ve grand-stranded that one. Wanted to go back door
I didn’t want that to be my Nick Castellanos facing the Tigers tweet
